summary: Well-structured test suite with comprehensive coverage of core functionality (semver parsing, commit classification, changelog generation, file I/O, CLI, integration). Good edge case testing and clear organization by module. Primary concern: workflow.test.ts references fixture files (fixtures/commits-feat.txt, fixtures/commits-fix.txt, fixtures/commits-breaking.txt) that are not shown in the provided code — if these files are missing, the workflow integration tests will fail. Assuming fixtures exist with correct content, this would be 5/5. Minor coverage gaps: no explicit test for non-conventional commit messages with BREAKING-CHANGE footer, no stress testing of large commit logs. Tests use appropriate fixtures (temp directories, cleanup), have good naming, and would catch most regressions in core logic. Workflow tests are complex but necessary; they properly validate YAML structure, actionlint compliance, and end-to-end behavior via act.
